summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. Nothing committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per instructions; all verification was by reading. Deviations to review: added mode and name properties on the reader (typing.IO's abstract properties would block instantiation); suppressions limited to readinto (no-untyped-def, override), readline (override), and the handle's readinto call (attr-defined), with no return-value or type-var suppressions, which is untested; the module-level open implementation uses a Literal mode annotation so overload calls type-check; Progress.wrap_file raises ValueError when the task total is None.
